summary.text: Mary Edly-Allen has represented the 31st District in the Illinois Senate since 2023.

paragraphs.text: She previously represented the 51st House district in the 101st General Assembly.
She has a B.A. in education from Northeastern Illinois University and a master's degree in curriculum and instruction from National Louis University.
The legislature biography describes her as assistant director of adult education at Mundelein High School and a co-founder of the educational nonprofit Foundation46.
